summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a routine Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that the EMA's Committee for Orphan Medicinal Products adopted a positive opinion recommending maintenance of orphan medicinal product designation for once-weekly TransCon CNP (navepegritide) in pediatric achondroplasia. The designation would confer 10 years of EU orphan market exclusivity upon European Commission adoption. This follows a positive CHMP opinion for marketing authorization; the final EC decision is expected in Q4 2026, with first EU launch as YUVIWEL in Germany expected Q1 2027. No transaction terms, pricing, or structural mechanics are stated.
